mapper.select: SELECT ra.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title, a.real_name as audit_admin_name FROM renew_application ra LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ra.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON ra.borrow_id = br.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN admin a ON ra.audit_admin_id = a.id WHERE ra.id = #{id}

SELECT ra.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title FROM renew_application ra LEFT JOIN teacher t ON ra.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON ra.borrow_id = br.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE ra.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY ra.apply_date DESC
